40164-history-of-the-opera-from-its-orig.creator: Unknown
40164-history-of-the-opera-from-its-orig.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Rousseau, and after him, with characteristic exaggeration, by R. Wagner, that "Opera" does not mean so much a musical work, as a musical, poetical, and spectacular work all at once; that "Opera" in fact, is "the work," _par excellence_, to the production of which all the arts are necessary.[1] The very titles of the earliest operas prove this notion to be incorrect.

arxiv-1407-1783.title: Simulating X-ray Observations with Python
arxiv-1407-1783.creator: John A. ZuHone, Veronica Biffi, Eric J. Hallman, Scott W. Randall, Adam R. Foster, Christian Schmid
arxiv-1407-1783.description: Abstract X-ray astronomy is an important tool in the astrophysicist’s toolkit to investigate high-energy astrophysical phenomena. Theoretical numerical simulations of astrophysical sources are fully three-dimensional representations of physical quantities such as density, temperature, and pressure, whereas astronomical observations are two-dimensional projections of the emission generated via mechanisms dependent on these quantities.

arxiv-2011-14318.title: A Framework for Health-informed RUL-constrained Optimal Power Flow with Li-ion Batteries
arxiv-2011-14318.creator: Jiahang Xie, Yu Weng, Hung D. Nguyen
arxiv-2011-14318.description: Abstract Battery energy storage systems are widely adopted in grid-connected applications to mitigate the impact of intermittent renewable generations and enhance power system resiliency. Degradation of the battery during its service time is one of the major concerns in the deployment that strongly affects the long-term lifetime.

arxiv-2103-08298.title: Knowledge driven Description Synthesis for Floor Plan Interpretation
arxiv-2103-08298.creator: Shreya Goyal, Chiranjoy Chattopadhyay, Gaurav Bhatnagar
arxiv-2103-08298.description: Abstract Image captioning is a widely known problem in the area of AI. Caption generation from floor plan images has applications in indoor path planning, real estate, and providing architectural solutions. Several methods have been explored in literature for generating captions or semi-structured descriptions from floor plan images.

arxiv-2112-04973.title: Optimized scintillation strip design for the DANSS upgrade
arxiv-2112-04973.creator: and D. Zinatulina
arxiv-2112-04973.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by and D. Zinatulina. DANSS is a one cubic meter plastic scintillator detector with a primary goal of sterile neutrino searches at a commercial nuclear reactor. Due to its highly advantageous location, fine segmentation and ability to change the distance to the neutrino production origin, DANSS is ahead of many similar experiments around the world in terms of the counting rate, signal to background ratio and sterile neutrino exclusion regions. Yet a moderate energy resolution of the detector prevents further progress in the physics program.

arxiv-2212-08181.title: Preferential stiffness and the crack-tip fields of an elastic porous solid based on the density-dependent moduli model
arxiv-2212-08181.creator: Hyun C. Yoon, S. M. Mallikarjunaiah, Dambaru Bhatta
arxiv-2212-08181.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the preferential stiffness and the crack-tip fields for an elastic porous solid of which material properties are dependent upon the density. Such a description is necessary to describe the failure that can be caused by damaged pores in many porous bodies such as ceramics, concrete and human bones.

arxiv-2303-14547.title: The gap-size influence on the excitation of magnetorotational instability in cylindrical Couette flows August 7, 2026
arxiv-2303-14547.creator: G. Rüdiger \aff 1,2 \corresp, M. Schultz \aff 2
arxiv-2303-14547.description: Abstract The excitation conditions of the magnetorotational instability are studied for axially unbounded Taylor-Couette flows of various gap widths between the cylinders. The cylinders are considered as made from both perfect-conducting or insulating material and the conducting fluid with a finite but small magnetic Prandtl number rotates with a quasi-Keplerian velocity profile.

arxiv-2401-07591.title: Multimodal Crowd Counting with Pix2Pix GANs
arxiv-2401-07591.creator: Muhammad Asif Khan 1 , Hamid Menouar 1 and Ridha Hamila 2 1 Qatar Mobility Innovations Center, Qatar University, Doha, Qatar 2 Department of Electrical Engineering, Qatar University, Doha, Qatar mkhan@qu.edu.qa, hamidm@qmic.com, hamila@qu.edu.qa
arxiv-2401-07591.description: Abstract Most state-of-the-art crowd counting methods use color (RGB) images to learn the density map of the crowd. However, these methods often struggle to achieve higher accuracy in densely crowded scenes with poor illumination. Recently, some studies have reported improvement in the accuracy of crowd counting models using a combination of RGB and thermal images.

arxiv-2405-00558.title: Cross-Cluster Networking to Support Extended Reality Services
arxiv-2405-00558.creator: Theodoros Theodoropoulos 1 2 , Luis Rosa 3 , Abderrahmane Boudi 4 , Tarik Zakaria Benmerar 4 , Antonios Makris 1 2 , Tarik Taleb 5 6 , Luis Cordeiro 2 , Konstantinos Tserpes 1 2 ,and JaeSeung Song 6
arxiv-2405-00558.description: Abstract Extented Reality (XR) refers to a class of contemporary services that are intertwined with a plethora of rather demanding Quality of Service (QoS) and functional requirements. Despite Kubernetes being the de-facto standard in terms of deploying and managing contemporary containerized microservices, it lacks adequate support for cross-cluster networking, hindering service-to-service communication across diverse cloud domains.

arxiv-2405-08644.title: Thinking Tokens for Language Modeling
arxiv-2405-08644.creator: David Herel, Tomas Mikolov
arxiv-2405-08644.description: Abstract How much is 56 times 37? Language models often make mistakes in these types of difficult calculations. This is usually explained by their inability to perform complex reasoning. Since language models rely on large training sets and great memorization capability, naturally they are not equipped to run complex calculations.

arxiv-2406-04232.title: Multidimensional Stability of Planar Travelling Waves for Stochastically Perturbed Reaction-Diffusion Systems
arxiv-2406-04232.creator: M. van den Bosch, H. J. Hupkes
arxiv-2406-04232.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by M. van den Bosch, H. J. Hupkes. We consider reaction-diffusion systems with multiplicative noise on a spatial domain of dimension two or higher. The noise process is white in time, coloured in space, and invariant under translations. Inspired by previous works on the real line, we establish the multidimensional stability of planar waves on a cylindrical domain on time scales that are exponentially long with respect to the noise strength.

arxiv-2501-03745.title: Strong Gravitational Lensing by Compact Object without Cauchy Horizons in Effective Quantum Gravity
arxiv-2501-03745.creator: Suvankar Paul
arxiv-2501-03745.description: Abstract In this work, we theoretically investigate strong gravitational lensing effects and evaluate various lensing observables of a static, spherically symmetric solution in the context of effective quantum gravity (EQG). Among the three types of solutions proposed in EQG backgrounds, this is the third type without having Cauchy horizons.

arxiv-2604-06094.creator: Dmitry Chirkov, Igor Lobanov

pmc-10681811.title: Bronchus compression is a predictor for reobstruction in coarctation with hypoplastic arch repair
pmc-10681811.creator: Chengyi Hui, Qiushi Ren, Jian Zhuang, Jimei Chen, Xiaohua Li, Hujun Cui, Jianzheng Cen, Gang Xu, Shusheng Wen
pmc-10681811.description: OBJECTIVESThe surgical treatment of coarctation of aorta with hypoplastic aortic arch (CoA/HAA) was challenging to achieve long-lasting arch patency. We reviewed early and late outcomes in our centre and identified predictors for arch reobstruction.METHODSA retrospective analysis of medical records was performed to identify CoA/HAA patients who underwent primary arch reconstruction via median sternotomy between 2011 and 2020.

pmc-10744631.title: Pilot Lipidomics Study of Copepods: Investigation of Potential Lipid-Based Biomarkers for the Early Detection and Quantification of the Biological Effects of Climate Change on the Oceanic Food Chain
pmc-10744631.creator: Paul L. Wood, Michael D. Wood, Stan C. Kunigelis
pmc-10744631.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Maintenance of the health of our oceans is critical for the survival of the oceanic food chain upon which humanity is dependent. Zooplanktonic copepods are among the most numerous multicellular organisms on earth. As the base of the primary consumer food web, they constitute a major biomass in oceans, being an important food source for fish and functioning in the carbon cycle. The potential impact of climate change on copepod populations is an area of intense study.

pmc-11474881.title: Transvenous extraction and reimplantation procedures for quadripolar left ventricular leads with an active fixation side helix
pmc-11474881.creator: Takehiro Nomura, Tsuyoshi Isawa, Shigeru Toyoda, Kennosuke Yamashita, Taku Honda
pmc-11474881.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Five ASQ extraction cases from our hospital were showed in this list. All leads were completely removed and there were no serious complications. Laser sheaths were used in four of the five cases.

pmc-11635093.title: Snakes and Ladders: The experience of being referred to and seen by Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services
pmc-11635093.creator: Kristina L Newman, Kapil Sayal, Colleen Ewart, Alexandra Lang, Anupam Bhardwaj, Bernadka Dubicka, Tamsin Marshall, Louise Thomson
pmc-11635093.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundReferral processes in Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) have been reported as stressful and inadequate by young people and parents/carers, who struggle during waiting periods for the referral outcome decision.

pmc-11698562.title: Endothelial progenitor cells as an angiogenic biomarker for the diagnosis and prognosis of lung cancer
pmc-11698562.creator: Fadi Najjar, Hassan Alsabe, Hussein Sabbagh, Ghassan Al-Massarani, Abdulmunim Aljapawe, Nissreen Alamalla, Issraa Banat, Adnan Ikhtiar
pmc-11698562.description: BackgroundAngiogenesis is mediated by endothelial progenitor cells (EPCs) derived from bone-marrow. In this prospective study, we tried to investigate the clinical utility of circulating EPCs in lung cancer (LC) patients.Materials and methodsFlow cytometry technique was used to assess circulating EPCs according to the immuno-phenotype CD45− CD34+ CD133+ CD146+ mononuclear cells.

pmc-12571990.title: Exploring Adverse Blood Donation Reactions Among Whole Blood Donors at a Tertiary Hospital Setting: A One‐Center Observational Mixed‐Methods Study
pmc-12571990.creator: Redeemer Nana Fabea Addae, Patience Sobre, Inusah Abdul Mumin, Addo Samuel Siaw, Nichodemus Parker Quansah, Abigail Asmah-Brown, Prosper Junior Awittor, Joseph Boachie, Patrick Adu
pmc-12571990.description: BackgroundAlthough blood donation saves lives, it may be associated with adverse reactions. These reactions may be immediate or delayed and may be a factor in donor nonreturn. However, there is limited knowledge about blood donation–related adverse reactions and risk factors specific to the Ghanaian context.

pmc-12659481.title: Infection prevention and control in the CT suite: a qualitative study with Australian radiographers in intravenous contrast administration
pmc-12659481.creator: Dania Abu Awwad, Suzanne Hill, Sarah Lewis, Yobelli Jimenez
pmc-12659481.description: BackgroundWithin radiology departments, computed tomography (CT) has been identified as presenting a higher risk of infection compared to other imaging modalities. CT scanning often deploys contrast injectors to administer iodine contrast intravenously, which poses infection risks for patients and staff.

pmc-12734344.title: The Performance of Protein Meal from Hermetia illucens Larvae in Hetero-Clarias Hybrid Farming
pmc-12734344.creator: Bogdan Georgescu, Carmen Georgescu, Tudor Păpuc, Marius Vasiu, Dănuț Struți, Anca Boaru, Rudy Caparros Megido
pmc-12734344.description: Simple SummaryIn this study, we tested whether fishmeal, a commonly used ingredient in aquafeeds, can be partly replaced with black soldier fly (Hermetia illucens) larvae meal. We have also checked if adding a commercial enzyme complex (Hostazyme X) would help fish absorb this insect-based feed better.

pmc-13083382.title: Effects of Pelargonium sidoides root extract on paw oedema, nitric oxide signaling, and synovial vascular changes in a rat model of adjuvant-induced arthritis
pmc-13083382.creator: Samime Sarli Gunduz, Dikmen Dokmeci, Ozgur Gunduz, Ufuk Usta, Fatma Nesrin Turan
pmc-13083382.description: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is characterized by chronic synovitis with pannus formation and progressive joint destruction. Pannus growth relies on angiogenesis, and nitric oxide (NO) contributes to vascular and inflammatory signaling. Although Pelargonium sidoides (PS) has not been evaluated in experimental arthritis, prior work suggests that PS can modulate NO production in activated macrophages.

pmc-13102962.title: Wafer-scale manufacturing of ultra-broadband, high-power erbium-doped integrated lasers
pmc-13102962.creator: Xinru Ji, Xuan Yang, Yang Liu, Zheru Qiu, Grigory Lihachev, Simone Bianconi, Jiale Sun, Andrey Voloshin, Taegon Kim, Joseph C Olson, Tobias J Kippenberg
pmc-13102962.description: Erbium (Er) is an attractive gain medium for amplifiers and lasers due to its long excited-state lifetime, low noise and nonlinearity, and temperature stability. Recently developed ultra-low-loss Si3N4 photonic integrated circuits combined with Er ion implantation have enabled high-performance on-chip Er lasers, but manufacturing scalability has been limited by the high 2 MeV implantation required for tightly confined 700-nm-thick waveguides.

pmc-13141431.title: Impact of indoor residual spraying and insecticide-treated nets on malaria burden in 8 districts in West Nile and Acholi regions, Uganda: a quasi-experimental study
pmc-13141431.creator: Jane F Namuganga, Daniel P McDermott, Adrienne Epstein, Joaniter I Nankabirwa, Samuel Gonahasa, Jimmy Opigo, Isaiah Nabende, Catherine Maiteki-Sebuguzi, Moses R Kamya, Martin J Donnelly, Grant Dorsey, Sarah G Staedke
pmc-13141431.description: BackgroundIn Uganda, where malaria transmission is high, insecticide treated nets (ITNs) have been distributed nationwide every 3 years since 2013. In West Nile, northern Uganda, indoor residual spraying (IRS) was first implemented with clothianidin-deltamethrin (Fludora Fusion®) in 2022, followed by pirimiphos-methyl (Actellic® 300CS) in 2023.
